newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht drops further, interbank dips late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht drops further, interbank dips late.

text.p: The Thai baht eased further against the dollar in late trade on Tuesday reflecting the greenback's sustained rise against major currencies abroad, dealers said.
The baht was quoted at 26.090/26.095 to the dollar late compared with 26.060/26.065 in early morning trade, dealers said.
"There was very strong buying of the dollar today. This was in line with the dollar's surge abroad," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
The overnight interbank rate was down to 9.50-9.75 percent late from 10.50-11.00 in early morning and 10.00-10.50 late on Friday, dealers said.
"Most foreign banks appeared to have surplus liquidity. Their lending into the market helped ease strong demand for funds by some local banks," said one money market dealer.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was traded at 6.00/6.50 satangs per dollar late against 6.80/7.30 in early morning.
